verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents an official CLI ([coderabbit-probe-3], [coderabbit-docs-2]) that it explicitly says can "run reviews in CI/CD pipelines" and integrate with AI coding agents ([coderabbit-docs-59]). It also documents Claude Code triggering reviews "without manual intervention" ([coderabbit-docs-17]) and advertises reviews "in agent loops" ([coderabbit-docs-60]). A published OpenAPI spec ([coderabbit-probe-2]) and a community suggestion to call its API from a GitHub Action ([coderabbit-comm-9]) further support programmatic, headless use. missing for 10: detailed docs on headless/non-interactive CLI flags, CI authentication (API keys/tokens), exit codes or machine-readable output, and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
